nodes.Name: sortComments
nodes.DocComment: sortComments sorts the list of comment groups in source order.

nodes.Name: CommentMap
nodes.DocComment:
A CommentMap maps an AST node to a list of comment groups
associated with it. See [NewCommentMap] for a description of
the association.

nodes.Name: nodeList
nodes.DocComment: nodeList returns the list of nodes of the AST n in source order.

nodes.Name: commentListReader
nodes.DocComment: A commentListReader helps iterating through a list of comment groups.

Fields.Name: pos
Fields.DocComment: source interval of comment group at current index

Fields.Name: end
Fields.DocComment: source interval of comment group at current index

nodes.Name: nodeStack
nodes.DocComment:
A nodeStack keeps track of nested nodes.
A node lower on the stack lexically contains the nodes higher on the stack.

nodes.Name: push
nodes.DocComment:
push pops all nodes that appear lexically before n
and then pushes n on the stack.

nodes.Name: pop
nodes.DocComment:
pop pops all nodes that appear lexically before pos
(i.e., whose lexical extent has ended before or at pos).
It returns the last node popped.

nodes.Name: NewCommentMap
nodes.DocComment:
NewCommentMap creates a new comment map by associating comment groups
of the comments list with the nodes of the AST specified by node.

A comment group g is associated with a node n if:

  - g starts on the same line as n ends
  - g starts on the line immediately following n, and there is
    at least one empty line after g and before the next node
  - g starts before n and is not associated to the node before n
    via the previous rules

NewCommentMap tries to associate a comment group to the "largest"
node possible: For instance, if the comment is a line comment
trailing an assignment, the comment is associated with the entire
assignment rather than just the last operand in the assignment.

nodes.Name: Update
nodes.DocComment:
Update replaces an old node in the comment map with the new node
and returns the new node. Comments that were associated with the
old node are associated with the new node.

nodes.Name: Filter
nodes.DocComment:
Filter returns a new comment map consisting of only those
entries of cmap for which a corresponding node exists in
the AST specified by node.

nodes.Name: Comments
nodes.DocComment:
Comments returns the list of comment groups in the comment map.
The result is sorted in source order.
